title: DevSuperSuite Enterprise Solution Architecture Reference Blueprints & Onboarding Matrix
summary: Standardized machine-readable reference blueprints and 30-day onboarding checklists across Financial Services, Defense, Healthcare, and Hyperscale Unicorn verticals.

week1.milestoneGate: Milestone Gate 1: Zero-Egress Airgap Attestation Sign-off

Stage cryptographically signed OmniKernel binaries into enterprise internal Artifactory/Nexus mirror
Hardware-rooted TPM 2.0 PCR register validation and platform attestation
Provision offline Ed25519 asymmetric enterprise license certificates

week2.phaseName: AST Context Baseline Benchmarking & Monorepo Topology Mapping

Execute automated prompt load tests: verify 83.5% token reduction across monorepos
Tune enterprise .omnikernelrc exclusion masks, macro expansions, and recursion depth

week3.phaseName: AgentShield Pre-Commit Invariant & CI/CD Gate Enforcement

Calibrate Shannon entropy scanning (H >= 4.50 bits/char) against corporate secret vault patterns

Integrate AgentShield verification runner into GitLab CI / GitHub Actions / Jenkins pipelines

Verify 18.4-day capital payback status and net capital surplus

Sign formal production cutover acceptance certificate
Activate Tier-1 24/7/365 enterprise support SLA and dedicated TAM coverage
